evidence.timing_transfer: exact per-chunk kernel-name sequence alignment partitioned at stable HC combine delimiters; stack-only support kernels deleted; timing-only kernels require a direct signature or identical left/right IR semantics; no fuzzy-name or duration matching

profile_summary.timing_coverage: 100% of kernels across the full 8k eager prefill request (4×2048-token runtime chunks)
profile_summary.node_time: active GPU time; overlap counted once
profile_summary.kernel_detail: GPU residency from the stack-disabled timing trace
profile_summary.provenance: Python-stack IR attribution transferred by exact per-chunk, HC-delimiter-partitioned kernel-name sequence alignment onto the stack-disabled timing trace

profile_summary.request_shape: one global BS1 / 8k-token request, executed as 4×2048-token chunks

timing.scope: full prefill request on the selected reference rank
timing.elapsed_source: profiler-selected full-request iteration bounds

profile_summary.gap_note: device gap is request elapsed minus the union of all GPU kernel intervals on the reference rank; its CPU/synchronization cause is not inferred without direct evidence
profile_summary.node_elapsed_coverage: decoder-stack envelope only; per-node eager-prefill elapsed/gap requires explicit invocation markers because concurrent streams interleave logical layers

timing.elapsed_source: profiler-selected full-request iteration bounds

profile_summary.gap_note: device gap is request elapsed minus the union of all GPU kernel intervals on the reference rank; its CPU/synchronization cause is not inferred without direct evidence
profile_summary.node_elapsed_coverage: decoder-stack envelope only; per-node eager-prefill elapsed/gap requires explicit invocation markers because concurrent streams interleave logical layers

assumptions.semantic_math: The complete non-MTP TP4 decode contract is preserved; every compute, state, and collective boundary in the selected Model/Execution IR has an explicit cost or structural status.
assumptions.fusion_policy: Ideal local costs use semantic fusion within a node and compulsory traffic only; module totals are serial sums of their semantic leaf lower bounds.
assumptions.overlap_policy: The top-level critical path follows the explicit decoder sequence. No speculative cross-layer overlap is credited; measured CUDA kernel overlap remains runtime evidence only.
assumptions.tensor_core_policy: Dense BF16 mathematical work uses the explicit dense GB300 Tensor Core peak; non-GEMM helpers use the same peak only as a safe lower bound and remain uncalibrated.
assumptions.cache_policy: Each layer owns distinct weights. At BS1, routed-MoE compulsory weight traffic includes the ten selected experts per layer; QSA attention uses the configured 2048-token sparse budget.
assumptions.evidence_policy: Projection and expert dimensions are reconciled against the eager trace with record_shapes; CUDA Graph supplies production timing but does not redefine semantic shapes.

coverage.coverage_semantics: declared adapter nodes; not additive timing coverage

critical_path.note: Full semantic ideal coverage for the selected non-MTP TP4 BS1 decode step. Attainable SoL remains unavailable until exact-shape launch, GEMM, attention, MoE, and collective calibration surfaces are attached.
